meta.name: email-subject-line-optimizer
meta.description: A/B test subject line variations using proven copywriting frameworks. Predict open rates based on historical performance.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要提升邮件打开率并优化主题行文案。
copy.tagline_en: Test subject lines with copywriting frameworks and predict open rates.

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude becomes an email marketing expert, generating high-performing subject lines, predicting open rates, and providing A/B testing recommendations.
